svg.title: Sideways Crab Shipping Co. share certificate
svg.desc: A joke share certificate of SIDEWAYS CRAB SHIPPING CO., printed in one ink with a red wax seal. The vignette shows a big crab walking sideways along the shore, with a sailing ship on the sea behind it. Under the name it says THIS CERTIFIES NOTHING, and a sheet of five numbered coupons hangs below a perforation.
